boundary: GPU board only, as reported by NVML. Excludes host CPU, DRAM, NICs, fans outside the board, power-supply losses, and facility overhead (PUE).
device_choice: lowest energy per unit of work among devices measured at the same workload, phase, batch, and token counts. measured_clear: its 95% interval lies below the others'. measured_every_run_pair: it also wins for every pairing of one run per device (added after measurement, once the two A100 boards differed by more than the trial intervals)
estimates: RunFootprintModel accelerator energy, it_ratio=1, pue=1, at two device powers: registry TDP, and Engine.solve's proportional rule TDP x (idle + dynamic x utilization). Modeled time from ServingModel (prefill: ttft at seq_len=prompt_tokens, decode: itl at the plan's model_seq_len rule) or SingleNodeModel (batch / training throughput). Utilization is the package's FLOP count over time x peak FLOP/s.
interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over trials, warm-up trials excluded
